parsed.why: No criminalisation and no documented police targeting of trans visitors, but 2018 official climate finding of hostility to visible trans people, an unresolved 2019 LGBTQ leader death, camp harassment, and zero statutory recourse; thin, dated tier-3 hostility.

Constitutional gender-identity protection, marriage equality and legal gender change, but contested enforcement, dated police campaigns directly targeting gender presentation (2001, 2004), no current police posture, and a post-2021 crackdown climate; protections real but unevenly operating.

Colonial-era felony sodomy provisions reach a trans woman read as male, no gender-identity protection, no hate-crime or custody rules; enforcement documented absent (last 2013), no government abuses or violence recorded — criminalisation with thin relief caps it below neutral.

Gender identity and expression covered in hate-crime and hate-speech law with an operating dataset, legal gender recognition in force; principal exposure is a 2025 changing-room restriction at one national pool chain, contested, plus narrowing youth care — low but not frictionless.

Article 120 prosecutions through 2023, routine police detention, extortion and coerced informing of gay men and trans women, forced examinations amounting to torture with impunity, constitutional omission of SOGI, unregistrable organisations — state-tolerated targeting with no recourse.
